endorsements.quote: Testing can be done retrospectively or in “silent mode,” 27 where predictions are observed without impacting patient care.
After scaled deployment, AI tools require ongoing surveillance to track performance, safety, and equity over time.
AI solutions must demonstrate that they improve health outcomes, reduce harm, and contribute to better overall patient experiences 45 .
Assess efficacy and fairness across subpopulation
Adopting a clinical trials framework ensures that AI solutions are thoroughly tested for safety, efficacy, and effectiveness before widespread implementation.
Cost should be factored in with pragmatic outcomes, patient-oriented outcomes, or other meaningful outcomes to justify testing and scaling the technology.

unlisted_practices: Disseminate findings and lessons learned so that other institutions can learn and share best practices.
Engage diverse stakeholders during pre-deployment planning of AI implementation.
Consider a solution's financial viability during early planning stages.
Use override comments and iterative alert review to improve clinical uptake of AI tools.
Use standardized test case libraries for regular validation, periodically used by vendors to monitor performance.
Governments and industry should fund and sponsor rigorous study of AI technologies.

screen.reason: This paper presents a conceptual framework and implementation roadmap informed by clinical trial phases to guide the safe deployment, monitoring, and governance of AI in healthcare organizations.
